instruction: I want to add animations to my slides. Please open the Animation pane.

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(5); pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(5); pyautogui.press('esc'); time.sleep(0.3); pyautogui.press('f10'); time.sleep(0.3); pyautogui.press('right', presses=2, interval=0.1); time.sleep(0.3); pyautogui.press('down', presses=11, interval=0.1); pyautogui.press('enter')

metadata.explanation: Task requires opening the Animation pane in LibreOffice Impress. The evaluator checks the accessibility tree for Animation pane elements. Similar difficulty to original - simple pane visibility task.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement: checks if Animation pane is visible in LibreOffice Impress
Getter (get_accessibility_tree) appropriately extracts UI state needed for verification
Metric logic is sound: searches for Animation pane elements using multiple strategies (panel and scroll-pane tags with 'Animation' in name)
Complete coverage: instruction has single requirement (open Animation pane) and evaluator checks exactly that
Correct parameter handling: metric receives empty rules dict as expected parameter, which is appropriate for binary presence check
No postconfig needed: Animation pane should remain visible after task completion
Robust implementation with XML parsing error handling
